■ Graveyard evolution—Choose a darkness creature in your graveyard and put this card into the battle zone on top of that creature.
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, put the top 2 cards of your deck into your graveyard.

■ このクリーチャーがバトルゾーンに出た時、自分の山札の上から2枚を墓地に置く。
